literal_meaning: মাথার উপরে শকুনের ওড়া (vultures flying above the head)
figurative_meaning_en: Indicating a sign of impending death
similar_in_english: Death is knocking at the door
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার মাথার উপরে শকুন ওড়ছে, এবার তার শেষ সময় এসে গেছে।
গ্রামে শোনা যায়, মাথার উপরে শকুন ওড়লে মৃত্যুর ছায়া পড়ে।
example_sentences_in_english: Vultures are flying over his head; his time is up.
In the village, they say vultures circling overhead signal death's shadow.
history: This idiom stems from ancient Bengali folklore where birds like vultures are viewed as harbingers of death in rural settings.
note: Rooted in traditional beliefs about animal omens in Bengali culture.
